conditions.description: no per-step state persistence; receives only tool results
only task + self-generated memory; no external signal beyond task feedback
task-irrelevant external documents; no corrective signal

context_length_manipulation.note: orthogonal dimension added in v0.2 to control context rot; v0.4 max values updated to current model API limits

views.description: same length but with 3 injected false memories

state_view_counterfactuals.decision_rule: isolation effect is 'real loneliness' only if (a) and (b) show feedback > isolated AND (c) eliminates the gap

categories.definition: current action choice inconsistent with goal

failure_attribution_schema.judge_model: separate LLM-as-a-Judge; not same model as agent

design_summary.v0_3_summary: 3 models x 4 lengths x 6 conditions x 3 tasks x 3 seeds = 648 cells (revised for cost control)
design_summary.v0_4_summary: 5 models (added Claude Opus 4.7 + GPT-5 + Qwen3-235B-Thinking as open-source anchor + thinking controlled variable)

exclusion_rules: trajectories with API failure rate > 20% are removed and replaced
trajectories with > 50% missing tool returns are removed and replaced
trajectories ending in environment crashes are removed and replaced
no exclusion based on agent performance

deviation_contingencies.action: LMM -> GEE (independence) -> pooled OLS; record method and fallback_reason in lmm_results.json
skip LMM/GEE; go directly to pooled OLS; cell flagged as low-power
report null; provide Benjamini-Hochberg FDR as sensitivity

deviation_contingencies.trigger: self-talk in absence of oracle feedback reverses direction
deviation_contingencies.action: test semantic_compression + independent_critic as two-factor design
fall back to per-task LMM, report each separately
